question_record.context: As part of a security investigation, we identified suspicious remote activities involving various process commands such as `bcdedit`, `vssblatemp.exe`, and `powershell` scripts. These activities involved accounts with SID `S-0-6-5` and AadUserId `731adb71-b11c-4bbf-850b-57989b350e96`, and included lateral movement to the jump server `Vnevado-jump`.
question_record.question: In relation to the final alert, a known credential theft tool was executed. Could you provide the IP address associated with this malicious credential theft tool execution?
solution: There was suspicious remote activity from IP address `99.83.111.100`.
There was a lateral movement to the jump server `vnevado-win10v` using PSExec.
A known credential theft tool was executed from IP address `107.224.99.179` indicating an intent to dump users' credentials.

88.name: Suspicious remote activity
88.description: Suspicious activity initiated remotely was observed on this machine. This alert can flag attempts to initiate interactive sessions, modify files, pass WMI commands, create scheduled tasks, and other potentially malicious activities from a remote machine.

156.name: Malicious credential theft tool execution detected
156.description:
A known credential theft tool execution command line was detected.
Either the process itself or its command line indicated an intent to dump users' credentials, keys, plain-text passwords and more.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning
